body.name: Mirrored-edge-sign assignment law
body.construction: Draw all displayed signs independently and uniformly from \(\{-1,+1\}\). If \(T\) is even, let \(m_T=(T-2)/2\) and \(Z=(A_1,\ldots,A_{m_T},B,-A_{m_T},\ldots,-A_1)\). If \(T\) is odd, let \(m_T=(T-3)/2\) and \(Z=(A_1,\ldots,A_{m_T},B,C,-A_{m_T},\ldots,-A_1)\). Draw \(X_1\) independently and set \(X_{t+1}=X_tZ_t\); \(D_T^{\mathrm{mir}}\) is the resulting law of \(X\).
